lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit higher pixel intensity in the center, tapering at the edges, with at least four distinct vertical columns visible in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with the dorsal edges reflecting high intensity and the ventral edges characterized by deep shadows, running parallel along the upper half of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least three smaller elongated teleost silhouettes (remoras) visible beneath the ventral-posterior edge of the pectoral fin and along the lower flank.
